Discover published public events without authentication. Each item uses the attendee-safe event serializer: id, slug, title, description, visibility, timezone, currency, published_at, created_at plus the categories, event_dates, event_media, event_organizations and event_streams associations. Owner-only fields (status, version, organization, event_setting) are never included.

Exposes id, slug, title, description, visibility, timezone, currency, published_at, created_at plus the categories, event_dates, event_media, event_organizations and event_streams associations. Never leaks status, version, organization or event_setting.

item.name: Approve Registration
item.description: Approve a pending manual registration as an authorized event manager. Automatic approval may also be recorded by the internal workflow. Reuse the same Idempotency-Key only for the identical decision.

item.name: Reject Registration
item.description: Reject a pending manual registration with an optional attendee-visible reason.

item.name: Reconsider Registration
item.description: Replace a rejected registration's effective decision through an audited manager-only reconsideration.

item.name: Enqueue Registration On Waitlist
item.description: Keep the registration as the queue entry when waitlisting is enabled. Registrants may enqueue their own registration; organizers may enqueue within their event scope.

item.name: Accept Waitlist Offer
item.description: Accept an active offer as the verified registrant. Free offers confirm immediately; paid offers return to the ordinary payment-order action.

item.name: Offer Next Waitlisted Registration
item.description: Promote the oldest complete waitlisted party that fits available inventory. Concurrent workers use row locking and do not split a party.

item.name: Issue Complimentary Ticket
item.description: Issue a normal confirmed zero-charge registration to a phone identity. Authorized event managers must provide a controlled reason and idempotency key. The command consumes ordinary package limits, inventory, venue capacity, forms, and consent gates, and creates no order or financial rows.

item.name: List Registration Consent Requirements
item.description: List privacy-safe exact-version consent requirements. Document bodies, hashes, subject IDs, and acceptance evidence are excluded.

item.name: Accept Registration Consent
item.description: Accept the exact published-or-retired snapshot requirement as the authenticated verified subject. Reuse the same request_uuid and Idempotency-Key only for the identical request.

item.name: Withdraw Registration Consent
item.description: Withdraw optional or required personal consent as the original verified signer. Buyer contract withdrawal is rejected. The response contains completion state only.

item.name: Grant Purchase Limit Override
item.description: Grant one immutable, audited exception to the registration user's purchase limit. Platform admins and event catalogue managers only. Reuse the same Idempotency-Key only for the identical request.
